specs.tagline: India’s most accessible and reliable city car with 1.0L K10C DualJet engine and 33.85 km/kg S-CNG efficiency.
specs.description: The Maruti Suzuki Alto K10 offers ultra-compact city dimensions, peppy 1.0L K-Series DualJet performance, SmartPlay Studio 7-inch touchscreen with smartphone connectivity, and unbeatable running economy with AGS automatic and S-CNG choices.
pros: Extremely accessible price tag and low maintenance cost for budget buyers
Nimble 4.5m turning radius making congested city navigation effortless
Punchy 1.0L DualJet engine returning up to 24.90 kmpl and 33.85 km/kg in CNG
cons: Basic safety package limited to dual front airbags and ABS
Rear cabin width is best suited for 2 adults rather than 3

specs.tagline: Bold micro-SUV stance with 180mm ground clearance, high seating position, and 25.30 kmpl AGS efficiency.
specs.description: The Maruti Suzuki S-Presso infuses micro-SUV attitude into entry hatchbacks with high 180mm ground clearance, upright seating commanding a great road view, dynamic center console with SmartPlay Studio, and efficient K10C DualJet engine.
pros: High 180 mm ground clearance easily handling tall potholes and speed breakers
Commanding high seating position providing great forward visibility for new drivers
Impressive fuel efficiency of up to 25.30 kmpl in AGS and 32.73 km/kg in S-CNG
cons: Polarising upright boxy design may not appeal to all buyers
Lightweight build feels unsettled over high-speed expressway undulations

specs.tagline: India’s most fuel-efficient petrol hatchback with 3D organic sculpted styling and 26.68 kmpl mileage.
specs.description: The all-new Maruti Suzuki Celerio leads the entry hatchback segment with energetic 3D organic design, 313-litre boot, 7-inch SmartPlay Studio touchscreen, push-button start, and segment-best fuel economy up to 26.68 kmpl and 34.43 km/kg in S-CNG.
pros: Segment-leading fuel efficiency of up to 26.68 kmpl in AGS and 34.43 km/kg in S-CNG
Large 313-litre boot space offering excellent luggage carrying capability
Light controls and tight 4.7m turning radius making it an effortless city commuter
cons: Cabin insulation is average with noticeable 3-cylinder engine thrum under load
Safety suite is limited to dual front airbags and ABS

specs.tagline: The iconic Big New Wagon R tall-boy hatchback offering cavernous cabin room, 341L boot, and 34.05 km/kg CNG.
specs.description: The Maruti Suzuki Wagon R continues to be an Indian household favourite with its tall-boy stance, easy ingress/egress, generous 341-litre boot, 1.0L and 1.2L DualJet engine options, and stellar fuel economy reaching 34.05 km/kg in S-CNG.
pros: Huge headroom and upright seating posture with easiest ingress and egress in class
Generous 341-litre luggage compartment easily swallowing large bags
DualJet engine options (1.0L and 1.2L) delivering remarkable fuel economy
cons: Tall-boy profile results in noticeable body lean around brisk corners
Basic highway insulation with tyre and wind noise entering at 100+ km/h

specs.tagline: 4th Generation icon with all-new high-efficiency Z-Series 3-cylinder engine and 6 airbags standard across all variants.
specs.description: The all-new 4th Generation Maruti Suzuki Swift features athletic exterior styling, an ultra-frugal Z12E 1.2L 3-cylinder engine returning up to 26.25 kmpl, standard 6 airbags across every trim, wireless Apple CarPlay/Android Auto, and rear AC vents.
pros: Standard 6 airbags across every single trim level from base LXi to ZXi Plus
Incredible ARAI fuel efficiency delivering up to 26.25 kmpl (Petrol) and 33.60 km/kg (CNG)
Modernized interior with 9-inch SmartPlay Pro+, wireless charger, and rear AC vents
cons: 3-cylinder engine has a mild thrum at idle compared to the previous silky 4-cylinder K12
Rear passenger seat space remains cozy compared to its Baleno sibling

specs.tagline: 4th Generation compact sedan with 5-star GNCAP safety, standard 6 airbags, electric sunroof, and 36.47 km/kg CNG.
specs.description: The all-new 4th Generation Maruti Suzuki Dzire sets a benchmark for Indian compact sedans with a 5-star Global NCAP safety rating, standard 6 airbags across all variants, single-pane electric sunroof, 9-inch SmartPlay Pro+, 360 camera, and ultra-frugal Z-Series engine.
pros: 5-Star Global NCAP crash test rating with standard 6 airbags on all variants
Segment-first electric sunroof, 360-degree surround camera, and wireless charging
Sensational fuel economy up to 25.71 kmpl (Petrol) and 36.47 km/kg (S-CNG)
cons: 3-cylinder Z-Series engine produces mild vibrations at low RPM compared to old 4-cylinder K12
Rear seat headroom is slightly snug for passengers over 6 feet tall

specs.tagline: Compact Urban SUV built on Suzuki Global C-platform with 360 camera, HUD, and electric sunroof.
specs.description: The Maruti Suzuki Brezza is India’s premier compact SUV combining an upright muscular stance with SmartPlay Pro+ 9-inch touchscreen, electric sunroof, 360-degree camera, Head-Up Display, 6 airbags, and efficient K15C / Boosterjet petrol powertrains.
pros: Rugged Global C platform with proven crash safety and 198 mm ground clearance
Feature-packed cabin with Head-Up Display, 360-degree camera, and electric sunroof
Smooth 6-speed torque converter automatic with paddle shifters and frugal S-CNG option
cons: No diesel powertrain option available
Cabin plastics feel functional rather than ultra-luxurious in lower trims

specs.tagline: India’s undisputed king of 7-seater MPVs with Smart Hybrid tech, paddle shifters, and versatile 3-row comfort.
specs.description: The Maruti Suzuki Ertiga is India’s favourite family MPV offering 7-seat versatility, cooled cup holders, roof-mounted AC vents with independent controls, SmartPlay Pro touchscreen, 6-speed automatic with paddle shifters, and factory-fitted S-CNG.
pros: Unmatched 7-seater space packaging and comfort in the sub-₹15 Lakh bracket
Frugal 1.5L Smart Hybrid petrol returning 20.51 kmpl and 26.11 km/kg in CNG
Smooth 6-speed automatic transmission with convenient steering paddle shifters
cons: Boot space with all 3 rows up is limited to 209 litres
No diesel or turbo-petrol engine option for heavy highway hauling

specs.tagline: India’s most utilitarian people and cargo mover with 1.2L K-Series power, sliding doors, and up to 540L cargo volume.
specs.description: The Maruti Suzuki Eeco is the backbone of Indian commercial and large-family transport, offering flexible 5 and 6-seater layouts, sliding rear passenger doors, cavernous 540-litre cargo area, peppy 1.2L DualJet petrol engine, and reliable S-CNG technology.
pros: Enormous interior space and 540L boot volume offering unmatched utility per rupee
Convenient sliding rear doors for easy loading and unloading in tight city alleys
Proven, robust rear-wheel-drive platform with durable low-cost maintenance
cons: Utilitarian cabin with minimal sound insulation and basic plastic finishes
No power steering or power windows on base configurations

specs.tagline: India’s bestselling premium hatchback with Head-Up Display, 360 View Camera, and outstanding 24.77 kmpl efficiency.
specs.description: The Maruti Suzuki Baleno defines the Indian premium hatchback segment with spacious rear seating, SmartPlay Pro+ 9-inch infotainment, Head-Up Display, 360 View Camera, standard 6 airbags on upper trims, and class-topping fuel efficiency up to 34.47 km/kg in S-CNG.
pros: Segment-best fuel economy with up to 24.77 kmpl in petrol and 34.47 km/kg in CNG
Generous cabin width with exceptional rear legroom and wide 318L boot
Segment-first tech including Head-Up Display and 360-degree surround camera
cons: Lightweight Heartect platform feels soft at high highway speeds
No turbo petrol engine option for enthusiastic drivers

specs.tagline: Dynamic coupe-crossover with striking NEXWave grille, 1.0L Boosterjet turbo performance, and 190mm ground clearance.
specs.description: The Maruti Suzuki Fronx is a sub-4m coupe SUV bringing aggressive styling inspired by the Grand Vitara, featuring punchy 1.0L Boosterjet turbo petrol with 6-speed paddle-shift AT, Head-Up Display, 360 view camera, and 6 airbags.
pros: Eye-catching aerodynamic coupe SUV silhouette with geometric LED light bar
Punchy 1.0L Boosterjet turbo petrol delivering brisk mid-range punch
Plush ride quality over rough roads with generous 190 mm ground clearance
cons: Rear passenger headroom is slightly compromised by the sloping roofline
Does not offer an electric sunroof option

specs.tagline: Iconic ladder-frame off-roader with ALLGRIP PRO 4WD low-range transfer case, 3-link rigid axles, and standard 6 airbags.
specs.description: The Maruti Suzuki Jimny 5-door delivers uncompromised go-anywhere 4x4 capability with a tough ladder frame chassis, 3-link rigid axle coil suspension, ALLGRIP PRO 4WD with low-range transfer case, standard 6 airbags, LED headlamp washers, and SmartPlay Pro+ 9-inch screen.
pros: Authentic ladder-frame 4x4 with low-range transfer gear for serious rock crawling
Compact footprint and lightweight build making it nimble on tight mountain trails
Standard 6 airbags, ESP, and hill descent control across all variants
cons: Modest boot space of 208L requires packing light for multi-day expeditions
Naturally aspirated 1.5L petrol lacks brisk highway overtaking punch at speeds above 100 km/h

specs.tagline: Premium mid-size SUV engineered with Toyota featuring Intelligent Electric Hybrid, ALLGRIP AWD, and panoramic sunroof.
specs.description: The Maruti Suzuki Grand Vitara is a premier urban SUV offering Intelligent Electric Hybrid powertrain returning 27.97 kmpl, ALLGRIP Select AWD capability, panoramic sunroof, ventilated leatherette seats, 360-degree camera, and Head-Up Display.
pros: Class-leading fuel efficiency of 27.97 kmpl in Intelligent Electric Hybrid
Available ALLGRIP Select 4x4 with electronic drive modes for adverse weather
Plush high-spec cabin with panoramic sunroof, ventilated seats, and 360 camera
cons: Strong Hybrid battery pack intrudes into boot volume (265L vs 373L)
3-cylinder hybrid motor generates noticeable drone under steep hill climbs

specs.tagline: Premium 6-seater MPV from Nexa with 2nd-row luxury captain chairs, ventilated front seats, and 360 camera.
specs.description: The Maruti Suzuki XL6 elevates family road trips with dedicated 2nd-row captain chairs, front ventilated seats, 360-degree surround view camera, SmartPlay Pro touchscreen, 6-speed automatic with paddle shifters, and frugal K15C Smart Hybrid power.
pros: Supreme comfort for middle-row passengers with individual reclining captain chairs
Segment-exclusive ventilated front seats keeping occupants cool during Indian summers
Smooth 6-speed torque converter AT with steering-mounted paddle shifters
cons: No 7-seat bench option available for families requiring extra seating capacity
3rd-row legroom and boot space are modest for long journeys with 6 adults

specs.tagline: The pinnacle of Nexa luxury — 2.0L Intelligent Electric Hybrid with 2nd-row luxury captain chairs and panoramic roof.
specs.description: The Maruti Suzuki Invicto is the brand’s flagship luxury MPV, combining TNGA monocoque architecture, 2.0L Intelligent Electric Hybrid delivering 23.24 kmpl, 2nd-row luxury captain chairs with powered ottomans, panoramic sunroof with ambient lighting, powered tailgate, and 360-degree camera.
pros: First-class rear seat luxury with powered ottoman captain chairs and panoramic glass roof
Sensational fuel efficiency of 23.24 kmpl in a full-sized 4.75-metre 7/8 seater MPV
Monocoque chassis delivering car-like ride refinement and effortless steering agility
cons: Premium price tag approaching ₹35 Lakh on-road in top-spec Alpha Plus trim
Does not include Level 2 ADAS features available on some segment competitors

specs.tagline: Stylish, feature-loaded city hatchback with standard 6 airbags and Bi-Fuel Hy-CNG option.
specs.description: The Hyundai Grand i10 Nios combines youthful hatchback proportions, standard 6 airbags across every trim, smooth Smart Auto AMT, and efficient 1.2L 4-cylinder Kappa petrol and CNG options.
pros: Standard 6 airbags across all trims for class-leading standard safety
Refined and reliable 1.2L 4-cylinder Kappa engine
Smooth Smart Auto AMT with easy city maneuverability
Factory-fitted CNG option delivering up to 27.0 km/kg
cons: No front center armrest or 60:40 split rear seat
Boot space compromised in CNG variants due to tank placement

pros: Class-leading cabin width and premium rear legroom
Bose 7-speaker premium audio and massive 10.25-inch infotainment in Asta (O)
Refined 1.2L Kappa petrol with smooth IVT automatic
All-round safety suite with standard 6 airbags and ESC
cons: Turbo petrol engine discontinued on standard i20 (exclusive to N Line)
Top-spec Asta (O) automatic pricing crosses ₹12.5 Lakh on-road

specs.tagline: Feature-packed micro SUV with standard 6 airbags, electric sunroof, and factory Bi-Fuel CNG.
specs.description: The Hyundai Exter is an urban micro SUV built on Hyundai's K1 architecture, offering standard 6 airbags across every trim, voice-controlled electric sunroof, dual-camera dashcam, and high-efficiency CNG options.
pros: Standard 6 airbags across all variants from base HX 2
Segment-leading 391-litre boot space and spacious headroom
Smart Auto AMT available with paddle shifters
Factory-fitted Bi-Fuel Hy-CNG Duo option delivering up to 27.1 km/kg
cons: No turbo-petrol or diesel engine available
Narrow rear seat width for 3 well-built adults

specs.tagline: Sub-4m compact SUV with ADAS Level 1, 118 bhp turbo-petrol, and 20.99 km/l diesel efficiency.
specs.description: The Hyundai Venue combines punchy Turbo GDi and frugal CRDi diesel engines with standard 6 airbags, connected car suite, voice-controlled sunroof, and segment-first ADAS Level 1 driver assistance.
pros: Punchy 1.0L Turbo GDi petrol and frugal 1.5L CRDi diesel engines
Level 1 ADAS available on top HX 10 trims
Crisp 8-inch digital infotainment with wireless smartphone connectivity
Comprehensive 6 airbag standard safety package
cons: Rear seat legroom can feel tight for 3 adults on long journeys
Ride quality is on the firmer side over sharp road undulations

specs.tagline: Modern urban crossover with distinctive design and efficient Kappa petrol engine.
specs.description: The Hyundai Bayon is an urban crossover slotting alongside the sub-4m SUV segment, offering a spacious 411L boot, high seating position, and cutting-edge Hyundai digital cockpit technology.
pros: Distinctive modern crossover styling
Spacious 411-litre boot capacity
Refined 1.2L Kappa petrol with smooth CVT automatic
Comprehensive safety with standard 6 airbags
cons: Tentative expected launch pricing
No diesel or turbo-petrol powertrain confirmed yet

specs.tagline: India's bestselling mid-size SUV with panoramic sunroof, Level 2 ADAS, and 38 verified variants.
specs.description: The Hyundai Creta dominates India's mid-size SUV segment with 38 verified variants spanning 1.5L Petrol, 1.5L CRDi Diesel, and 158 bhp Turbo GDi engines with Manual, IVT/CVT, Torque Converter, and 7-Speed DCT options.
pros: Unrivaled powertrain depth with 38 variants spanning petrol, diesel, and turbo
Panoramic sunroof, dual 10.25-inch screens, and ventilated seats
Hyundai SmartSense Level 2 ADAS active safety suite
Class-leading cabin ergonomics and 433L luggage compartment

Turbo-petrol 7DCT commands a notable price premium

specs.tagline: 4-star Global NCAP hatchback with innovative twin-cylinder iCNG technology.
specs.description: The Tata Tiago is a feature-rich, dynamic compact hatchback renowned for its sturdy 4-star Global NCAP safety rating and segment-first twin-cylinder iCNG technology that preserves luggage boot space. Offering refined manual and AMT automatic transmissions across both petrol and CNG powertrains.
pros: 4-star Global NCAP adult safety rating — class-leading build quality
Segment-first twin-cylinder CNG technology preserving usable boot space
First-in-segment CNG automatic (AMT) option for effortless city commuting
Punchy 8-speaker Harman audio system on top-spec variants
Plush ride quality and confident high-speed highway stability
cons: 3-cylinder Revotron engine can produce noticeable cabin vibrations at idle
Rear seat legroom is tighter than Maruti WagonR and Grand i10 Nios
AMT transmission exhibits occasional hesitation during sudden kickdowns

specs.tagline: Next-gen compact sedan with 6 standard airbags, ventilated seats, and dual-cylinder iCNG technology.
specs.description: Tata Aeris is Tata Motors' next-generation sub-4m compact sedan that succeeds the Tigor. Underpinned by 1.2-litre petrol and bi-fuel CNG engines with manual and AMT transmissions, it offers segment-first features including ventilated front seats, twin-cylinder CNG technology, built-in dashcam with DVR, 10.25-inch infotainment, and standard 6 airbags.
pros: Standard 6 airbags across all variants from base model
Segment-first ventilated front seats on top trim
Innovative twin-cylinder CNG with usable boot space and AMT automatic option
Modern dual-screen dashboard with 10.25-inch touchscreen and wireless connectivity
cons: 3-cylinder engine NVH can be noisy under heavy acceleration
Rear seat width is slightly snug for three large adults
No sunroof or ADAS options offered in this segment

specs.tagline: Next-Gen All-Electric Compact Sedan with 6 Airbags, Ventilated Seats, and 315 km Range
specs.description: The Tata Aeris.ev is Tata Motors' next-generation all-electric compact sedan, succeeding the Tigor EV. Built on refined Ziptron architecture, it features a 26.0 kWh liquid-cooled IP67 battery delivering 315 km certified range, 6 airbags standard from base trim, segment-first ventilated front seats, class-leading 419-litre boot space, and 10.25-inch dual-screen digital cockpit.
pros: Standard 6 airbags across all trims from base Smart variant
Segment-first front ventilated seats on top Creative Plus trim
Class-leading 419-litre luggage boot capacity
Affordable running cost of ~₹1.20 per km for daily urban commuting
Dual-screen cabin with 10.25-inch touchscreen and wireless connectivity
cons: Real-world highway range drops at continuous speeds exceeding 85 km/h
Rear seat head room is slightly compromised by the aerodynamic coupette roofline
No sunroof or ADAS options offered in this entry-sedan segment

specs.tagline: The Gold Standard of Indian Hatchbacks with 5-Star Safety, Twin-Cylinder iCNG, and DCA Automatic
specs.description: The Tata Altroz is India's premium hatchback built on the agile ALFA architecture, delivering a proven 5-star Global NCAP adult safety rating, spacious 5-seater cabin with signature 90-degree wide opening doors, and multiple advanced powertrain options: 1.2L Revotron petrol with segment-leading DCA dual-clutch automatic, innovative twin-cylinder iCNG retaining 210L usable luggage space, and frugal 1.5L Revotorq turbo-diesel.
pros: 5-star Global NCAP safety rating with 6 airbags and high-strength steel ALFA structure
Segment-first DCA dual-clutch automatic transmission with wet clutch pack and active cooling
Innovative twin-cylinder iCNG technology preserving 210L usable boot capacity with spare wheel access
Wide 90-degree opening doors for easiest ingress and egress in the premium hatchback class
Punchy, highly frugal 1.5L turbo-diesel powertrain with 200 Nm torque available across trims
cons: 1.2L 3-cylinder naturally aspirated petrol engine lacks mid-range punch during brisk highway overtaking
Engine noise and 3-cylinder vibrations audible at higher RPMs compared to 4-cylinder rivals
Rear seat under-thigh support is slightly shallow for taller adult occupants

specs.tagline: The 5-star micro-SUV — big safety in a bold package.
specs.description: The Tata Punch punches above its weight with a 5-star Global NCAP safety rating and authentic SUV stance. Built on the advanced ALFA architecture, it offers class-leading safety, twin-cylinder iCNG technology, and high-tech features like a 10.25-inch infotainment screen, voice-assisted sunroof, and wireless connectivity.
pros: 5-star Global NCAP safety rating (Adult protection)
Segment-first twin-cylinder CNG technology with usable boot
High 187mm ground clearance and commanding SUV driving posture
Available with electric sunroof, 10.25-inch infotainment & wireless charger
Available AMT automatic transmission across Petrol and CNG powertrains
cons: 3-cylinder engine note has noticeable vibrations at idle
No rear AC vents
AMT gearshifts can have noticeable pauses under hard acceleration

specs.tagline: The legend reborn — iconic design, cutting-edge tech, commanding SUV presence.
specs.description: The legendary Tata Sierra returns as a modern midsize lifestyle SUV, combining heritage-inspired wrap-around rear glass styling with cutting-edge technology. Featuring 1.5L Turbo Petrol Hyperion GDI and 1.5L Turbo Diesel powertrains, Level 2 ADAS, panoramic glass roof, and luxurious lounge seating options.
pros: Iconic Sierra design with modern wrap-around glass and signature lighting
Punchy 158 bhp Hyperion GDI Turbo Petrol and torquey 280 Nm Turbo Diesel engines
Level 2 ADAS suite and 5-star anticipated safety rating with 6 standard airbags
Premium lounge seating options with rear sunshades and fold-down amenities
Large panoramic sunroof, 12.3-inch touchscreen, and 10-speaker JBL audio
cons: No 4x4 / AWD option at launch (FWD only)
High-end trims command a noticeable premium over compact SUV rivals

specs.tagline: India's most popular compact SUV — 5-star safety, stylish design.
specs.description: The Tata Nexon is a compact SUV that revolutionised the segment with its 5-star Global NCAP safety rating. The 2023 facelift brings a bolder design, enhanced ADAS features, and a refined driving experience. Available in petrol, diesel, and electric variants.
pros: 5-star Global NCAP safety rating
Competitive pricing with rich feature set
ADAS available in top variants
Good ground clearance for Indian roads
Available in petrol, diesel, and EV
cons: Cabin quality lags behind Korean rivals
Rear seat comfort could be better
No ventilated seats
AMT can feel jerky in city traffic

specs.tagline: India's First Mass-Market Coupe SUV with ATLAS Architecture, Hyperion GDi, and Level 2 ADAS
specs.description: The Tata Curvv is a striking mid-size coupe SUV built on Tata's ATLAS (Adaptive Tech Forward Lifestyle Architecture). It combines an aerodynamic sloping roofline with an imposing 208mm ground clearance, massive 500L boot, flush door handles with welcome lights, panoramic sunroof with mood lighting, 123 bhp Hyperion direct-injection turbo-petrol and 1.5L Kryojet diesel mated to segment-first 7-speed DCA, and 5-star Bharat NCAP crash safety.
pros: Distinctive head-turning coupe SUV design with flush door handles and aerodynamic sloping silhouette
5-Star Bharat NCAP safety rating with 6 airbags standard and Level 2 ADAS suite
Segment-first diesel paired with 7-speed dual clutch automatic (DCA) with paddle shifters
Class-leading 500-litre luggage boot capacity with gesture-controlled powered tailgate
Feature-loaded interior with panoramic sunroof, ventilated seats, and 10.25-inch dual digital screens
cons: Coupe sloping roofline slightly restricts rear passenger headroom for occupants over 6 feet tall
Rear visibility through the steeply raked rear windscreen is tight (compensated by 360 camera)
Ride quality on top-spec 18-inch wheels is noticeably firm over sharp broken road surfaces

specs.tagline: Tata Harrier — Flagship 5-seater SUV built on Land Rover-derived OMEGARC platform with 5-Star Bharat NCAP safety and Level 2 ADAS.
specs.description: The Tata Harrier is a flagship midsize 5-seater SUV built on the Land Rover D8-derived OMEGARC platform. It pairs commanding road presence, a spacious cabin, and 5-Star Bharat NCAP safety with modern 1.5L TGDi Petrol and 2.0L Kryotec Diesel engines, dual-zone climate control, panoramic sunroof, 12.3-inch touchscreen, and Level 2 ADAS.
pros: Land Rover D8-derived OMEGARC architecture with phenomenal highway stability and ride compliance
Perfect 5-Star Bharat NCAP rating (31.08/32 adult, 44.52/49 child safety)
Comprehensive Level 2 ADAS suite and 360-degree surround view camera
Segment-leading interior luxury with 12.3-inch touchscreen and 10-speaker JBL cinematic sound
Ventilated front seats and voice-assisted panoramic sunroof with ambient lighting
cons: No 4x4 / AWD option available despite rugged styling and Land Rover platform roots
Large exterior dimensions make tight city parking and narrow U-turns demanding
Steering weighting in Sport mode can feel slightly heavy at slow speeds

specs.tagline: Tata Safari — Flagship 3-row 6/7-seater SUV built on Land Rover D8-derived OMEGARC platform with record Bharat NCAP 5-Star score and Level 2 ADAS.
specs.description: The Tata Safari is a flagship 3-row mid-to-large SUV built on the Land Rover D8-derived OMEGARC architecture. Available in versatile 6-seater (Captain Seats with ventilation) and 7-seater configurations, it delivers supreme long-distance comfort, highest-in-class Bharat NCAP 5-Star safety (33.05/32 adult), powerful 1.5L TGDi Petrol and 2.0L Kryotec Diesel engines, dual 12.3-inch screens, Level 2 ADAS, and JBL cinematic sound.
pros: Segment-highest 5-Star Bharat NCAP safety score (33.05/32 adult, 45.00/49 child safety)
Luxurious 6-seater option with ventilated 2nd-row captain seats and boss-mode adjustment
Superb road presence and highway composure on Land Rover D8-derived OMEGARC chassis
Comprehensive Level 2 ADAS suite and 360-degree surround view camera
12.3-inch cinematic touchscreen paired with 10-speaker JBL audio system
cons: No 4x4 / AWD option available despite rugged heritage and Land Rover architecture
Large dimensions and turning circle require caution in narrow congested streets
Limited boot space with all three seating rows deployed

specs.tagline: India's Most Accessible Electric Hatchback with Ziptron IP67 Battery and Multi-Mode Regen
specs.description: The Tata Tiago.ev is India's most popular compact electric hatchback, powered by Tata's proven Ziptron EV architecture. Available in 19.2 kWh Medium Range (170 km real-world / 250 km MIDC) and 24.0 kWh Long Range (215 km real-world / 315 km MIDC) liquid-cooled IP67 battery configurations with DC fast charging, multi-mode regenerative braking, and FATC automatic climate control standard.
pros: Extremely economical running cost of under ₹1.20 per km for urban commuting
Fully Automatic Temperature Control (FATC) climate control standard across all variants
DC fast charging capability (10% to 80% in 57 mins) on all variants
4-level adjustable regenerative braking with steering-mounted paddle shifters
Compact footprint with 5.1m turning radius ideal for tight city parking and congested traffic
cons: Real-world highway range drops noticeably above 80 km/h cruising speeds
Boot space is compact at 240 litres due to EV battery integration
Rear seat legroom and width are best suited for two adults rather than three

specs.tagline: India's Safest Electric Compact Sedan with 4-Star Global NCAP and 315 km Range
specs.description: The Tata Tigor.ev is India's most accessible electric sedan, combining sleek notchback styling with a certified 4-star Global NCAP adult crash safety rating. Powered by Tata's Ziptron architecture featuring a 26.0 kWh liquid-cooled IP67 battery pack delivering 315 km certified range, 74 bhp / 170 Nm electric motor, CCS2 DC fast charging, and a practical 316-litre boot.
pros: 4-Star Global NCAP adult occupant safety rating with proven structural integrity
Extremely economical running cost of approximately ₹1.25 per km for daily city commuting
Generous 316-litre dedicated luggage boot space with spare wheel integration
Fully Automatic Temperature Control (FATC) climate control standard across all variants
CCS2 DC fast charging capability replenishing 10% to 80% charge in 59 minutes
cons: Real-world highway driving range drops to ~200-220 km at speeds above 80 km/h
Rear seat head room is slightly compromised by the sloping notchback roofline
Lacks Level 2 ADAS and panoramic sunroof features available on newer EV competitors

specs.tagline: Built on the dedicated acti.ev pure EV platform with 5-star Bharat NCAP rating.
specs.description: The Tata Punch.ev is a groundbreaking electric micro-SUV built on Tata's dedicated acti.ev architecture. Offering up to 468 km claimed range with a 40 kWh battery, 5-star Bharat NCAP adult and child safety rating, 10.25-inch dual screens, 360-degree camera, front ventilated seats, and DC fast charging capability.
pros: 5-star Bharat NCAP safety rating for both adult and child occupants with 6 standard airbags
